name: v1.0.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Bringing over storage implementations by @kieronlanning in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/1
* Mongodb eventstore by @kieronlanning in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/2
* chore: package updates by @kieronlanning in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/3
* Package updates by @kieronlanning in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/4
* Updates by @kieronlanning in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/5
* Default data compression to true, add source generator package, sample app, comprehensive tests, CI workflow, and distributed tracing by @Copilot in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/6
* feat: holistic EventSourcing framework improvements — upcasting, snapshot strategy, tracing, perf by @Copilot in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/8
* chore: fix for Justfile on Windows- don't know why this is needed all of a sudden by @kieronlanning in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/9
* Copilot/investigate newtonsoft json removal by @kieronlanning in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/10
* ci: target self-hosted runner `t-x-kjldev` by @Copilot in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/7
* fix: correct CI and CD workflow packaging by @kieronlanning in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/11
* Fix CD release publishing for immutable GitHub releases by @Copilot in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/12
* Make CD release workflow idempotent when version tag/release already exists by @Copilot in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/13
* Release by @kieronlanning in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/14
* Automate release tag creation in CD workflow by @Copilot in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/15
* CD: make main-merge release flow robust with private draft releases by @Copilot in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/16

## New Contributors
* @kieronlanning made their first contribution in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/1
* @Copilot made their first contribution in https://github.com/kjldev/purview-eventsourcing/pull/6
